lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Want to go to the waterside this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Zhōumò tiānqì hěn hǎo.
lines.english: Great! The weather is nice this weekend.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 开车去吧。两个小时就到。
lines.pinyin: Kāichē qù ba. Liǎng gè xiǎoshí jiù dào.
lines.english: Drive there. Two hours and we're there.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Shuǐ, màozi, shuǐguǒ. Hái yǒu chī de.
lines.english: Water, a hat, fruit. And food.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What can we do at the waterside?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 游泳、跑步、看太阳。晚上吃好吃的。
lines.pinyin: Yóuyǒng, pǎobù, kàn tàiyáng. Wǎnshang chī hǎochī de.
lines.english: Swim, run, watch the sun. Eat something good in the evening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 听起来很有趣！那周末见。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai hěn yǒuqù! Nà zhōumò jiàn.
lines.english: Sounds fun! See you this weekend.
